## Linux package checklist

- [ ] Exact frozen server passes the release gauntlet.
- [ ] Pinned multiscript corpus passes through the frozen server.
- [ ] Launcher lifecycle and malformed-readiness tests pass.
- [ ] Portable tarball checksum and archive checks pass.
- [ ] AppImage builder digest passes.
- [ ] AppImage is reproducible in the same clean runner.
- [ ] Final AppImage launch smoke passes.
- [ ] x86_64 scope is stated; aarch64 is not overclaimed.
- [ ] No package or release asset is published without explicit approval.
